title: Book: Let's Talk Money — Monika Halan (2018)

text: Monika Halan's book is written for Indian households and focuses on avoiding costly mistakes, especially being sold the wrong products. Its recurring ideas, in plain terms: keep insurance and investing separate by buying pure term and health cover instead of endowment or ULIP-style policies; build an emergency fund first; match each goal to a timeline and use assets suited to it (equity for long goals, safer assets for near ones); keep costs low; and be wary of advice that earns commission on what it sells, because mis-selling is common in India. She encourages understanding the basics so you can judge advice. Treat this entry as a summary of the book's themes, and check current product rules and rates on official sites.
